Thank you for reaching out with your resume and interest in the job opening.

﻿

I am sorry to inform you that the employer refused to accept your candidature for the job at his company. ﻿﻿﻿However, if you are interested, we can assist you with applying your resume to other employers that hire workers from overseas.

 

We, at Green Light, work with more than 400 companies across Canada and assist them with the recruitment of local and foreign workers to fill their labor shortages. We are a licensed Canadian immigration and recruitment firm and we manage immigration and employment cases of candidates who were offered a job by Canadian employers we work for.

 

If you are interested, we can schedule you a call with me or one of my colleagues to discuss your employment opportunities and go over potential Canadian employers who would be interested in your application for their vacancies.

* Important to mention that we are committed to the zero-risk policy - If we fail in assisting you with getting a job offer, we shall not start the visa process, so you get a full refund of the deposit you paid. All this is mentioned in our retainer agreement.

 

* In order to initiate your immigration case and commence the visa process, we require a refundable deposit of $250. As soon as the report is ready (3-5 days),  you get a video consultation with our immigration specialist to understand the job opportunities as well as all the details of your visa process. This amount (250$) is included in the first installment of the work visa retainer agreement and will be 100% refunded to you if you do not obtain a job offer and we do not start your visa process within 3 months.
